A LITTLE MORE ABOUT ME

Designer by day.
Daydreamer, always.

I’m a brand identity designer, packaging enthusiast, and the person who will absolutely notice the font on your café menu.

I love stories with personality — in a brand, in a café, or in a K-drama I definitely meant to watch just one episode of. That curiosity finds its way into everything I make.

My favourite part? Turning a “what if…” into something you can see, hold, and share with the world.

HOW I SEE THINGS

A little heart.
A lot of intention.

01

Story comes first.

Before colours and type, we explore your audience, your goals and the feeling you want your brand to create.

02

Personality matters.

Playful or quietly refined, your identity should express what makes you interesting. There’s no one-size-fits-all here.

03

It all belongs together.

Your identity, packaging, social and print should feel like parts of the same story. One flexible world that grows with you.
